skill_name: Analyze the benefits and concerns of using artificial intelligence.
workflow: The use of artificial intelligence (AI) has both benefits and concerns. On the one hand, AI can help with automating mundane tasks and greatly enhance efficiency. AI can also reduce human error as machines can manage and process large amounts of data quickly, accurately, and consistently. A further benefit of using AI is that it allows businesses to make better, more informed decisions with the power of data.
